CARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE
Introduction
The most commonly diagnosed malignancy affecting men above middle age.
Exact cause not known
Risk factors
- Increasing age
- Presence of testicles
- Heredity – Cancer of the prostate in first degree relatives, inheritance of
faulty genes e.g. cancer of the breast in mother
- Ethnicity – commoner and more aggressive in the black race
- Environment –Industrial workers (rubber, textile, fertilizer)
- Obesity
